gameplayConstraints.reason: The reference's arm span scales to 1.17u at this height, but the narrowest walkable plank (segment 'beam', 1.2u wide) leaves 0.94u of visible deck after the platform edge band. A silhouette wider than that hides the player's own footing on the hardest segment in the game. Arms must tuck inboard of the reference; this is a deliberate, gameplay-driven departure, not a reconstruction error.
